lines.zh: 我贴着水底游，鳍几乎不摆。
lines.en: I glide along the bottom, fins barely moving.
One tail flick and I shoot two feet ahead.
I can slip through gaps in the coral.
The deep is cold, so I swim slower.
Eight hit points make a light frame.
I circle the reef looking for small fish.
The surface is too bright; I sink deeper.
I roll sideways, showing my pale belly.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼散了，我追最后一只。
lines.en: The school scatters; I chase the last one.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，水纹很细。
lines.en: My wake leaves only the faintest ripples.

lines.zh: 深海没有阳光，我靠别的找路。
lines.en: No sunlight down here; I find my way otherwise.

lines.zh: 我蹭过海草，惊起一片小虾。
lines.en: Brushing the kelp stirs up a cloud of shrimp.

lines.zh: 深水珊瑚礁是我的猎场。
lines.en: The deep coral reef is my hunting ground.
One tail beat and I vanish into the dark.

lines.zh: 我从礁顶滑下去，肚皮擦过珊瑚。
lines.en: I slide off the reef top, my belly scraping the coral.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，把水从鳃里挤出去。
lines.en: I open my mouth and push the water out through my gills.
Two of us patrol together, and I take the outer side.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面游，把自己藏进阴影。
lines.en: I swim close to the sand, hiding myself in shadow.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，张嘴等水流。
lines.en: I hang in the water, mouth open to the current.

lines.zh: 深水太安静，只有我的鳃动。
lines.en: The deep is so quiet only my gills move.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处的一点微光。
lines.en: I stare at a faint glow in the distance.
A small fish nears; I do not move.
I grind my teeth, very softly.
Only eight hit points; I must be careful.

lines.zh: 中型鲨鱼来过这里，我记得。
lines.en: A medium shark passed here; I remember.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的影子盖住我的背。
lines.en: Coral shadows cover my back.

lines.zh: 鳃盖轻轻扇着，推着水走。
lines.en: Gill covers fan softly, pushing water through.

lines.zh: 深温带海洋的冷，我习惯了。
lines.en: I am used to the cold of deep temperate seas.

lines.zh: 我数着头顶游过的大影子。
lines.en: I count the large shadows passing overhead.
I have not eaten all day.

lines.zh: 我靠着岩壁，鳍尖搭在缝上。
lines.en: I lean on the cliff, fin tips in a crevice.

lines.zh: 这片深水，我只占一小块。
lines.en: In this deep water I hold only a small patch.

lines.zh: 你沉下来了，比鱼大得多。
lines.en: You sank down here, far bigger than any fish.
I circle you, not daring to come close.
Your hand sways like bait.
I do not eat people, only small things.

lines.zh: 你身上的灯，晃得我眼花。
lines.en: The light on you dazzles me.
I stop downstream of you.
Your flipper moves and I back away.
You are bigger than a medium shark.
I open my mouth only to taste the water.
Do not move suddenly; I will flee.

lines.zh: 侧身掉了一片鳞，火辣辣。
lines.en: A flank scale tore loose and burns.
I have only eight hit points.
I flip over and swim away fast.

lines.zh: 这一下我记到下次换鳃。
lines.en: I will remember this until my gills change.
A thread of blood stretches in the water.
I hide in a coral crevice.
My fins are trembling.
One more and I am gone.
Half a fish is still in my mouth.
The sting makes me lose my bearings.

lines.zh: 你手里的生鱼肉，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the raw fish in your hand.

lines.zh: 我不夺，我等你手指松开。
lines.en: I will not grab; I wait for your fingers to open.
One small fish lasts me a day.

lines.zh: 你抖一抖，碎屑掉下来了。
lines.en: Shake it and the scraps fall.
I come half a foot closer, then stop.
I cannot swallow anything too large.

lines.zh: 你把鱼肉沉下来，别伸手。
lines.en: Sink the fish, and keep your hand back.
This bloody smell drowns out caution.
I circle once before daring to bite.
After this bite, I leave.

lines.zh: 你膝盖顶得我侧翻过去。
lines.en: Your knee tipped me onto my side.
My fin grazes your leg.
Do not crowd me; I have only eight hit points.
The current pushed you into me.
I dart off behind the reef.

lines.zh: 你的靴底压住我的尾鳍。
lines.en: Your boot sole pins my tail fin.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了两片鳞。
lines.en: That cost me two scales.
I slide along the sandy floor.
Make room; I am heading back to the deep.
After bumping you, I run first.
In the deep, companions are few.
Only one or two of us come per spawn.
I am not picky; company is enough.
A touch of tail fins counts as acquaintance.

lines.zh: 这条海沟太冷，独自游更冷。
lines.en: This trench is cold; swimming alone is colder.
We never build nests.
Want a mate? Head for warmer water.
A big shark scattered my companions.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，谁也不领先。
lines.en: We swim side by side, neither leading.
This fish, I leave for you.
I do not pick things up; I use teeth.
That piece of fish I swallow whole.
I have no hands, only fins.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，我绕着看。
lines.en: I circle whatever falls.

lines.zh: 这块东西比我整条鱼还沉。
lines.en: This thing weighs more than a whole fish.
A scale sinks; I nudge it aside.
I bite twice and my teeth ache.
You take it; I do not need it.

lines.zh: 我只对会游的东西有兴趣。
lines.en: I am only interested in things that swim.
That scrap of meat drifted away.
Small fish moving; I see them.
You are bigger than prey; I will watch first.
I have my eye on a small shrimp.
The target is small; one bite ends it.
I lower myself and approach along the bottom.
Something moves behind the coral.
I swim toward that school of fish.

lines.zh: 中型生物靠近，我改主意了。
lines.en: A medium creature nears; I change my mind.
Locked on; my tail fin tightens.
This time I will not chase anything too big.
I halt behind and to its side.
One more foot and my jaws open.
It still gnaws the kelp, never looking back.
The current pulls my scent downstream.
I measure the distance: a foot and a half.
Move once and I change position.
A large shadow overhead; I hide first.
I open my mouth and my teeth show.
It ducks into the reef; I wait.
One bite and it is done.
I bite the soft spot behind its gills.
My teeth are small but numerous.

lines.zh: 我甩动脖子，扯下一缕肉。
lines.en: I wrench my neck and tear off a strip.

lines.zh: 血雾在我鼻前散成一片。
lines.en: A mist of blood blooms before my snout.
This bite is worth only four damage.

lines.zh: 它挣了一下，我咬得更紧。
lines.en: It struggles and I bite harder.

lines.zh: 牙嵌进去，我就不再松开。
lines.en: My teeth sink in and stay locked.
The splash is small; the noise is not.
Reach in and I bite your fingers.

lines.zh: 咬完这一口，我马上溜走。
lines.en: After this bite I slip straight away.
The deep darkens and there I am.
Only one or two of us arrive each time.
I was born in the deep temperate ocean.

lines.zh: 这里的水压压得我舒服。
lines.en: The pressure here sits comfortably on me.
I swish my tail and find my bearings.

lines.zh: 深水珊瑚礁，我认得这座。
lines.en: Deep coral reef; I know this one.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋也能把我放出来。
lines.en: A spawn egg can place me too.
The moment I appear, I look for small fish.
Eight hit points, scarce from birth.

lines.zh: 头顶有大影子，我先沉底。
lines.en: A large shadow above; I sink to the bottom.
Fire underwater makes me dart about.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔下去，晕了一阵。
lines.en: I fell from the surface and blacked out briefly.
I have gills; how could water choke me?

lines.zh: 冲击震得我鳞都竖起来。
lines.en: The blast makes my scales stand on end.
A harpoon pierces my dorsal fin.
Violet light tightens my gills.
Hungry too long, my teeth grow soft.
Lightning hits the sea and I freeze.
The water beneath me suddenly vanished.
